semantics: equivalence-preserving representation re-optimization (vole optimize, master brief §44). optimize_stream parses a standalone stream and searches a bounded rewrite set, applying the first improving rewrite per iteration to a fixpoint (stream strictly shrinks, so the loop terminates). Every candidate is accepted only when the rebuilt stream is strictly smaller (J(D1) < J(D0)) AND decodes with the normative decoder to byte-identical frames (M(D0) == M(D1) proven by full decode, never trusted). Families in deterministic order: (1) velocity_collapse - a run of consecutive single-SetPosition groups with a constant delta (including the step from the pre-run position) becomes one SetVelocity + one AdvanceTranslations per frame (13 + len bytes vs 13*len); (2) trajectory_collapse - the Phase-I accel/piecewise parametric pass (reused collapse_stream); (3) residual_promotion - a maximal run of identical one-shot point-residual blocks becomes one persistent sparse overlay + the unchanged lane (closes the recorded Phase-G/K gap 'stable residuals pay one-shot per frame'); (4) generator_substitution - a declared raster object whose samples are exactly a bounded program (gradient/checker/periodic fits + byte-for-byte render check) is re-declared as that generator (samples never stored); (5) duplicate_merge - byte-identical object declarations share one record with references remapped. Palette-bearing streams are preserved verbatim (the rebuild path re-emits objects/instances/intervals only; recorded limitation, never a silent change). Noise is never substituted (unbounded seed search, §21). CLI: vole optimize <in.vole> <out.vole> prints before/after/rewrites/exact.

candidate_gates.equivalence: full normative decode of the rebuilt stream == original frames (byte-for-byte)
candidate_gates.fixpoint: loop bounded by the strictly shrinking byte count
candidate_gates.velocity_min_run: >= 2 groups, constant delta from p0, no prior velocity/trajectory on the instance (find_runs guards)
candidate_gates.residual_promotion_gate: run >= 2 identical single-residual groups; point blocks only; overlay stays under max_overlay_points; byte gate
candidate_gates.generator_gate: object raster >= 32 samples and the program declaration is strictly smaller

notes: No wire-format change in Phase O: optimization is purely a re-representation of the same v1 grammar; every optimized stream is decoded and byte-compared against the input before acceptance.
The decode-identity invariant is the Phase O contract: decoded_before_hash == decoded_after_hash holds for every accepted rewrite (the OptimizeReport.exact flag re-checks it at the end).

Recorded boundaries: palette streams are preserved verbatim; noise is never substituted; copy-decomposition, checkpoint placement, and per-frame entropy-model retuning remain re-encode territory (the court measures them as zero-savings fixpoints on current encoder output); the encoder's own output is already near-optimal for the families optimize knows, which is itself a measured result (inverse-gradient and noise streams: 0 B saved).
CLI wiring: vole optimize <in.vole> <out.vole>; the Phase-A proof stream (2692 B of 101 per-frame SetPosition groups) optimizes to 1505 B - exactly the Phase-E velocity baseline.
